biotools.summary: scRevol is an RL-based model designed to infer tumor evolution and characterize clonal structure from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. It utilizes CNV profiles to reconstruct evolutionary trajectories and resolve subclonal diversity in cancer.
